# AeroBrowse

Hybrid HTTP retrieval and isolated Chromium browsing for AI agents. This hardening candidate is not production-ready.

- [README](README.md): installation, API, MCP sessions and limitations
- [Security](SECURITY.md): network boundaries and open requirements
- [Audit](AUDIT.md): findings and remediation status
- [Benchmarks](BENCHMARKS.md): reproducible methodology
- [Engineering report](ENGINEERING_REPORT.md): verification and acceptance gaps
